gloss: active service; active duty; still active

definitions.explanation: Currently serving in a professional or official capacity, especially military or government.

definitions.gloss: still active; currently active; not yet retired
definitions.explanation: Still working, competing, or performing in one's field rather than having retired.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{現役|げんえき}の{軍人|ぐんじん}だ。
{現役|げんえき}の{警察官|けいさつかん}として{長年|ながねん}{働|はたら}いてきた。
examples.english: He has worked for many years as an active-duty police officer.

examples.japanese: {現役|げんえき}{時代|じだい}の{経験|けいけん}が、{退職後|たいしょくご}の{人生|じんせい}にも{役|やく}に{立|た}っている。
examples.english: Experiences from his active years are still useful in his life after retirement.

examples.japanese: あの{選手|せんしゅ}はまだ{現役|げんえき}だ。
{現役|げんえき}を{引退|いんたい}してからもう{十年|じゅうねん}になる。
examples.english: It has been ten years since he retired from active play.

examples.japanese: {七十歳|ななじゅっさい}を{過|す}ぎても{現役|げんえき}で{働|はたら}き{続|つづ}けている{医師|いし}は{少|すく}なくない。
examples.english: There are not a few doctors who continue working actively even past the age of seventy.

notes:
Combines {現|げん} (present, current) and {役|えき} (service, duty). Originally a military term for active service, now widely used to describe anyone who is still working or competing in their field rather than having retired.

USAGE:
- Functions as both a noun and a noun modifier ({現役|げんえき}の + noun)
- {現役|げんえき}を{退|しりぞ}く / {現役|げんえき}を{引退|いんたい}する: to retire from active service/play
- In education, {現役|げんえき}{合格|ごうかく} means passing an entrance exam on the first attempt (without taking a gap year)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現役|げんえき}{選手|せんしゅ}: active player
- {現役|げんえき}{時代|じだい}: one's active years
- {現役|げんえき}{引退|いんたい}: retirement from active service
- {現役|げんえき}{合格|ごうかく}: passing an exam on the first try
- {現役|げんえき}{最年長|さいねんちょう}: oldest active (player, etc.)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {活動中|かつどうちゅう}: currently active — describes ongoing activity rather than professional status
- {在職|ざいしょく}: in office, employed — focuses on holding a position
- {退役|たいえき}: retired from service — the opposite of {現役|げんえき}, especially in military contexts
